title: The Iron Hag Awake
summary: Word that Baba Yaga had woken and ruled Russia from behind a veil.

claims.text: Contact with the lands of the Iron Hag broke off, few who entered returned, and the Valkyries were the exception.
Only through them did the world learn that the Iron Hag was awake and steering what Kindred took for a Brujah-held Soviet Union, using demons, Cainites and Lupines.

title: Lodin and Modius in Chicago
summary: The struggle that gave Lodin control of Chicago.

claims.text: In 1908 Lodin warned the city's oldest Kindred that anarch actions threatened the Masquerade, and the elders allowed Lodin to end the conflict by any means.
A socialist leader whom Lodin had Embraced won over the city's Brujah, and Lodin set out to wipe out the anarchs.
By 1913 Lodin held the city and Modius fled.

title: Erciyes
summary: The Turkish mountain that held the heart of the Cappadocians.

claims.text: A ruined monastery atop Mount Erciyes was once the centre of the Cappadocian clan and a haven of Cappadocius between travels.
Augustus Giovanni was Embraced there, and the Clan of Death stored its knowledge there.

title: Haiti
summary: A Caribbean paradise for the Followers of Set.

claims.text: Haiti stands apart from the other Caribbean islands as a haven where the Followers of Set thrive amid Voodoo culture.

title: Hakari
summary: The eldest of the Kindred of Japan.

claims.text: Hakari is called the elder of elders among the childer of Hiruko, roughly a Prince of Tokyo or perhaps of all Japan.
Hakari holds court in the Imperial Palace, is the oldest undead in Japan, and has probably walked the land since the age of the daimyo.
Little is known of this figure.

title: Ian MacLaren
summary: A Ventrue banker who became Prince of Kingston, Ontario.

claims.text: Ian MacLaren, a banker of Scottish descent, was Embraced into Clan Ventrue in London in the 19th century.
After a string of financial mistakes in the 1970s, MacLaren was urged to leave and became Prince of Kingston, Ontario.

title: Jeremy MacNeil
summary: A Brujah leader of the Los Angeles anarchs.

claims.text: Jeremy MacNeil is a Brujah of the Eighth Generation, born in 1631 and Embraced in 1657.
MacNeil was born in the Scottish Highlands and was known as a skilled fighter among the clan.
MacNeil is a leading figure among the Los Angeles anarchs.
Qadi is the Tal'mahe'Ra title for the sect's counterpart of a justicar.

title: Qufur am-Heru
summary: A Setite title taken from the first ghoul of Set.

claims.text: An Egyptian title roughly meaning greatest who guards me, used in the hierarchy of the Followers of Set.
Legend says the first to bear it was the first mortal Set made a ghoul, a great warrior and chief advisor, who died defending Set's temple against Horus.
That ghoul bound the family to serve Set forever.

title: Arikel
summary: The Toreador Antediluvian, as legends tell it.

claims.text: Legends name the Toreador founder Arikel, a great sculptor or perhaps the finest dancer of the age.
Zillah is rumoured to be Arikel's sire, which would make Arikel a sibling of Nosferatu.
Despite the rivalry of the two clans, rumour holds that Arikel felt pity or even love for the disfigured sibling.
